CustomProperties.Name: LoadTemplate
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Loads in a template of approvals

CustomProperties.Name: MoveTemplateItemOrder
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Changes the order of items in the edit template screen

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    inputTDRID >= 0,
    ForAll(
        Filter(
            'VCDS 'VCDS THCEE — Approvals',
            'EHCR ID' = inputTDRID
        ) As Approval,
        Collect(
            colApprovalItems,
            {
                ID: Value(Approval.ID),
                TDRID: Value(Approval.'TDR ID'),
                SignedBy: Text(Approval.'Signed By'),
                SignedOn: Approval.'Signed On',
                Approver: Text(Approval.Approver),
                Order: Value(Approval.Order),
                DOA: Text(ParseJSON(Approval.Details).DOA),
                ActionSought: Value(ParseJSON(Approval.Details).ActionSought),
                Decision: Value(ParseJSON(Approval.Details).Decision),
                Position: Text(ParseJSON(Approval.Details).Position),
                Notes: Text(ParseJSON(Approval.Details).Notes)
            }
        )
    )
);
